decision.rationale: Exact 17-frame replay equality and event counts, differential ordered raster/RAM tests, timing/constraint gates pass. All three synthetic pre-swap workloads improve; representative GPU activity decreases. Ordinary CPU median unchanged and FPS near 30. Extra fitted cost 396 LEs and 12 M9Ks. Retain single-lane fallback and exact Stage 3 rollback; DMA remains disabled.
decision.scope: Synthetic resident meshes and standing/shared-terrain replays; not complete-game FPS or physical framebuffer acceptance

trial_order: dual then control; three resets for probe, ordinary standing and instrumented standing per image
coverage: 17 exact shared-terrain/fixture replay frames against accepted Stage 3 captures and exact seven event counters; excludes full actors/transitions/physical framebuffer and complete-level traversal. Raw bytes preserved.
